items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the stuff that was happening down in L.A., that was the Minguses and Dexter Gordons and the Sonny Clarks. That was a whole different scene.

ctx.x: Yeah, Shorty Rogers and the Bud Shank and everything, that was up in Hollywood, way up, but the stuff that was happening down in L.A., that was the Minguses and Dexter Gordons and the Sonny Clarks. That was a whole different scene.
